messages:
Maya Z: Heads up 1 1: found a few structured-output examples that use the new invoke envelope (`{result: ...}`) while the JSON Schema examples still show the raw shape. Strict validators will fail.

Owen L: Can you point to a page?

Maya Z: /docs/reference/structured-output.md and /docs/guides/invoke/quickstart. Also a couple of sample app links point at a branch that was deleted during the refactor.

Sophie L: Two small, low-risk fixes: 1) add an "envelope vs raw" note in structured-output with both schema snippets, 2) add a tiny docs-only unbox helper (`const unbox = x => x?.result ?? x`) and show how to use it before AJV validation. Mark as temporary.

Owen L: Agree. I'll batch link-fixes and the schema examples in one PR.

Alex M: Also add tests to the examples harness: run `unbox` on captured example outputs before validation so CI catches regressions.

docs-ci-bot: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1744 (files changed: 4) :gear:

Maya Z: Please include a Python helper too (some customers use the Python snippets). Short example: `def unbox(candidate): return candidate.get('result', candidate) if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate`.

Sophie L: Wording note: avoid the word "deprecated" in user-facing guides when referring to old helper names. Use "previous helper names" and include a migration table.

Owen L: Good call, updated PR text. Also added an inline comment near the unbox snippet: "// TODO: remove after snippets migrated (tracking: #1799)".

docs-ci-bot: CI status for PR #1744: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness passed. Ready to merge.

Alex M: Merged PR #1744 into main. I'll create the tracking issue #1799 and tentatively schedule a sweep in 2 weeks to remove the compat helper.

Maya Z: Thanks, all. Closing this thread.

Sophie L: One last small request: add a single-line note at the top of the invoke guide: "If you rely on our code samples, run `yarn docs:test-examples` to validate links and schema shapes locally."
